_comment: Copy to <project>/.semantic-router/routes.json. Encoder is any OpenAI-compatible /v1/embeddings endpoint; the default below is a local Unsloth/LM Studio server.
_thresholds: A route matches only if its similarity clears `threshold` AND leads the runner-up by `margin`. Chat-model embeddings have a high baseline, so the margin matters; raise it if unrelated messages match, lower it if valid ones don't. Inspect scores with the semantic-route tool.

routes.name: code-review
utterances: what is wrong with this function
check this code for security issues
routes.inject: This is a CODE REVIEW request. Read the code, then report concrete findings (bugs, edge cases, security, style) with file:line references. Do not rewrite unless asked.

routes.name: research
utterances: what does the evidence say about this
look up references for this claim
routes.inject: This is a RESEARCH request. Cite sources with links or ids; separate claim from evidence; state uncertainty explicitly.

routes.name: brainstorm
utterances: what are some options for this
routes.inject: This is a BRAINSTORM request. Produce a divergent list of options first, then a brief recommendation. Do not implement yet.
